services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Now is the best time to embark upon an extraordinary adventure that will forever change you. There truly is no adventure more extraordinary than skydiving. The safest, easiest, and most convenient way for San Francisco skydivers to try skydiving is via tandem skydive. Tandem skydiving is, without a doubt, the most common way to try skydiving. In the United States, approximately 500,000 people try skydiving for the first time every year. More than 99% of those do so as a tandem skydive. During a tandem skydive, you'll be harnessed to an experienced instructor who will guide you through every step of the jump, from training to the initial leap to landing. services.desc: Skydiving is an experience that words alone cannot capture. The rush of adrenaline, the breathtaking scenery, and the sense of accomplishment are best conveyed through visuals. Skydive video and pictures allow you to relive your transcendent experience repeatedly. They transport you back to that moment when you were flying through the sky, experiencing all the emotions, seeing things in a new way, and feeling on top of the world. The skydiving location plays a crucial role in creating stunning visuals, which translates into incredible freefall and parachute pictures and video. The backdrop can make all the difference, turning an already thrilling experience into a visually captivating one.
